text: An organism changed this way is a G M O; if it carries a gene from another species, it is transgenic. Bacteria making human insulin since nineteen eighty two. Bt cotton. Golden Rice, whose grain makes beta carotene, the raw material of vitamin A. A slow softening tomato. A soybean that survives a weed killer.
